subject: sociology
title: What is Crime? Adventure
welcome_lead: What counts as a crime? And what's just rude? ⚖️
meta_desc: Crime & Society Adventure 1 — KS3 Sociology on what crime is and how it's defined.
final_note: You learned what a crime is and the difference from deviance.

walkthroughs.body_html:
A crime breaks the law — written rules with state-set punishments.

Deviance breaks a norm — unwritten expectations like queueing politely.

What's a crime depends on time and place:

  • Cannabis legal in some US states, illegal in UK.
  • Drinking at 16 was once normal, now restricted.
  • Slavery was legal long ago — now a global crime.

Sanctions = social responses.

  • Positive — praise, awards.
  • Negative — fine, jail, exclusion.

Society uses sanctions to keep order. 🚓
